messages.text:
Dear Helium D. Team,

I am writing to you once again regarding my cancellation and refund request
for order Shop····, placed on October 2, 2026.

Since I have tried contacting you repeatedly without receiving any response
or acknowledgment, this is my final attempt to resolve this matter directly
with you.

Please be advised that if I do not receive a prompt reply and confirmation
of my full refund ($329.00 USD) within the next 24 hours, I will
immediately escalate this case to PayPal. I have compiled all my unanswered
emails and communication logs, and I will submit them to PayPal to initiate
a formal dispute and force a resolution on my behalf.

I expect an immediate confirmation of the cancellation and the full refund
to my original payment method.

Sincerely,

Aikaterini S.
Note to the team: I'll pull up the order before replying.
Handed to the team · Full refund / cancellation needs Abel or Georges to approve; threatened PayPal d

Dear Aikaterini,

Thank you for writing, and I am sorry you have had to chase us on this. You should not have had to send this message at all.

I have your order Shop···· in front of me, placed on October 2 for the Hammer Miner DC04 and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan, $329.00. Nothing on it has shipped. It is well past the five business days it should have taken, and there is no excuse for that.

The first thing I have done is put the order on hold on both the store and the warehouse side, so it cannot ship while this is being settled. That is in place now.

The cancellation and the refund itself have to be approved by one of the owners, Abel or Georges, and I have put your request in front of them with the full history. The team is offline today, Sunday, and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern. You will get their confirmation at this email address, in reply to this thread.

If you would rather not wait on that, I can turn the full amount into store credit on your account straight away, usable on anything we have in stock, and your Thor P2 order from the same day arrived on October 16, so you know the gear does land. Just say the word and I will do it today. Otherwise your cancellation request stands exactly as you wrote it.

I would simply ask that you give the team until tomorrow morning before taking it to PayPal, as a dispute freezes the order and stops us from settling it directly with you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your quick response and for putting the order on hold.

Since store credit can be applied immediately, I would gladly prefer to
convert the full amount ($329.00 USD) into store credit on my account
today. This way, I can use it right away to purchase a device that is
currently in stock and ready to ship.

Please go ahead and apply the store credit to my account, and let me know
once it is ready so I can place the new order.

Best regards,

Aikaterini S.

Στις Κυρ 25 Οκτ 2026 στις 22:48 ο χρήστης Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <
(email hidden)> έγραψε:
Note to the team: She's accepted store credit. Running the dispute check fresh, then the cancellation-to-credit.

Dear Aikaterini,

That is done. Order Shop···· is cancelled, and $329.00 in store credit is on your account now, under the email you are writing from.

It works at checkout: sign in with (email hidden), and the credit shows as a payment option on the payment step. You can put it towards anything on the site, and if the new order comes to less than $329.00 the rest simply stays on your account for next time. If it comes to more, you pay only the difference.

One thing worth knowing for (address hidden): anything we hold at our Rotterdam warehouse ships to you from inside the EU, so there is no import VAT or customs charge waiting for you on delivery. Before you order, tell me which unit you have your eye on and I will confirm whether it is on the shelf there and ships right away, rather than you finding out after the fact. I would rather check it for you than have you wait again.

Your Thor P2 from the same day was delivered on October 16, so that order needs nothing further.

Sorry again that the DC04 went the way it did.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for updating my account with the store credit.

I am interested in using this credit toward the Bitfortun BS-4 device.
Could you please let me know if this unit is currently in stock and
available for immediate shipping? If so, please let me know how I can apply
my store credit to complete this order, or if you can transfer it for me
directly.

Best regards,

Aikaterini S.

Στις Κυρ 25 Οκτ 2026 στις 23:31 ο χρήστης Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <
(email hidden)> έγραψε:
Handed to the team · Bitfortun BS-4 is a dropship SKU, so the ship-from country and whether EU import

Dear Aikaterini,

The B. BS-4 (18 TH/s) is live and buyable at $599.99, and we have units allocated to it. I want to be straight with you though, because you have already been let down once on a ship date: the BS-4 is not a unit sitting on our Rotterdam shelf. It is shipped direct from the manufacturer, and the ship date on it right now is October 31. So it is available, but it is not same-day dispatch.

On the money, your credit covers $329.00 of it, leaving $270.99 to pay, plus shipping calculated from your address at checkout.

I cannot place the order or move the credit onto it for you, since payment happens on our own checkout pages. It is simple at your end: sign in at checkout with (email hidden), and your $329.00 shows as an available payment method on the payment step. Apply it, then pay the remainder with your card or PayPal.

One last thing I would rather you hear now than after delivery. Because the BS-4 ships from the manufacturer and not from our EU warehouse, I am having the team confirm whether German import VAT or duty applies to it. They pick that up tomorrow at 10am Eastern and will reply here, so you may want to wait for that answer before you order.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

Ok, thank you for your help. I will wait for your update regarding the VAT,
as well as if you could let me know which devices are currently available
in your warehouse in Rotterdam.

I understand that I will need to pay any price difference depending on the
total amount of the new order.

Best regards,

Aikaterini S.
